cat >> specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md <<'EOF'

## 14. Conversation list

- "'`list_conversations` is accepted independently of feature configuration, with an optional integer `limit` from 1 through 200 and optional composite `before` cursor containing a parseable date string `updatedAt` and nonempty string `sessionId`; invalid windows name the invalid field, and unrecognized fields including `userId` are discarded ([validated by: validates history windows and rejects invalid limits or incomplete composite cursors](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).
- Without `transport.history.enabled: true`, or with a store lacking `listFor`, the server answers exactly one `error` with code `UNSUPPORTED`, keeps the socket open and sends no list ([validated by: refuses history unless opted in and supported by the store](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).
- A requested list is answered while a turn on the same session is pending, before that turn'"'s "'`stream_end`, independently of the per-session turn lock ([validated by: answers history before a pending turn can send stream_end](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).
- A store failure is answered with one `SERVER_ERROR` containing no store detail, logged with the session id and no user content or credentials, and leaves the socket open ([validated by: reports a failing store safely and keeps the socket usable](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L1)).

### Client frame fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | Yes | `list_conversations` |
| `limit` | integer | No | Page size, 1–200 |
| `before` | object | No | `{updatedAt, sessionId}` from the last row seen |
| `before.updatedAt` | string | With cursor | Activity time accepted by `Date.parse` |
| `before.sessionId` | string | With cursor | Nonempty session id breaking activity ties |

### Server frame fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | `conversation_list` |
| `conversations` | ConversationSummary[] | Requested page of the connection owner'"'s metadata |
| "'`conversations[].sessionId` | string | Conversation id usable with resume |
| `conversations[].createdAt` | string | ISO creation time |
| `conversations[].updatedAt` | string | ISO activity time |
| `conversations[].entryCount` | number | Stored entry count |

**GDPR.** `transport.history` is the deployer'"'s separate opt-in decision to expose one authenticated user's own conversation metadata to the client; the authorization and metadata-only wire contract are specified in [Conversation List](../hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md#over-the-websocket).
EOF

EOF

cat > .lore/dod.md <<'"'EOF'
# Definition of Done

> It does not give a **client** anything: the browser holding the socket cannot reach the store, so
> every consumer that wants a history sidebar has to stand up its own authenticated HTTP route over
> the same data the engine already authenticated on the upgrade.

**Strategy: "'`direct`** — `validateMessage` and `createHalEngine` are existing public seams. Acceptance tests use real WebSocket upgrades, the shipped in-memory store and provider, a forwarding store subclass to record actual arguments, and a public lifecycle hook to hold a real turn pending.

## Done when these pass

- [ ] **validates history windows and rejects invalid limits or incomplete composite cursors** — accepts the additive frame and validates composite pagination without a feature flag.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **lists only the authenticated owner, pages wire summaries and resumes a listed conversation** — authenticates through the upgrade, observes actual store arguments, ISO metadata, ordering, current-session inclusion, paging and existing replay.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **refuses history unless opted in and supported by the store** — default-off, explicit-off and an original five-member store all answer `UNSUPPORTED` without closing the socket.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **answers history before a pending turn can send stream_end** — history bypasses the turn lock.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **reports a failing store safely and keeps the socket usable** — a revoked real store callable exercises exception handling, sanitized output and session-scoped logging.
  `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`

## Facets

- [ ] Add the four protocol interfaces and union members additively, preserving all existing message literals and `ConnectedMessage`.
- [ ] Validate optional limits and complete composite cursors independently of configuration.
- [ ] Thread default-off history configuration from `createHalEngine` through `createServer` to the non-locked handler.
- [ ] Answer only requested, authenticated-owner metadata using the original pagination options and ISO timestamps.
- [ ] Return `UNSUPPORTED` for disabled history, absent `listFor`, or `StoreCannotList`; sanitize and log other store failures as `SERVER_ERROR`.
- [ ] Preserve existing resume/replay and warn at startup for history enabled without resume.
- [ ] Mirror the retention note pointing at #41 on the history options type; document the separate disclosure opt-in and resume dependency.
- [ ] Update `example/full-config.ts`, regenerate getting-started docs, add a consumer changelog entry and make the version change MINOR.

## Out of scope

- Titles, previews, deletion, operator access to another user'"'s conversations, server-side paging state and live synchronization between tabs.
- Production implementation in this acceptance-test commit.
EOF
